alt: Seated audience in a darkened conference hall looking toward a presentation

alt: Slice of layered sponge cake topped with fresh raspberries on a dark plate

alt: Two people collaborating at a silver laptop, one pointing at the screen and the other near the trackpad

alt: Studio photo of a modern grey upholstered chair with a high back and light wooden tapered legs

title: Snooker X Art

title: Urban Framework

alt: Dark Porsche Panamera Turbo driving on a highway at twilight, rear three-quarter view with motion blur
title: Vehicle Destruction

alt: Wide one-point perspective down a Manhattan avenue lined with skyscrapers and yellow taxis
